judged_text: The 'Supports updating the post' test asserts only post.cooked =~ /new contents/ and never verifies the content_sha1 bookkeeping (embed.update_column(:content_sha1, ...)) or that a re-import with unchanged contents skips the revision, which is the core idempotency contract of TopicEmbed.import's update branch (app/models/topic_embed.rb lines 30-35). If the content_sha1 comparison were broken (e.g. always unequal, causing PostRevisor to fire and re-notify watchers on every hourly poll), this test still passes because it only covers the changed-content path; a feed polled hourly would silently revise every topic every hour and no spec would fail.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds nontrivial idempotency logic in TopicEmbed.import: it computes content_sha1 and only calls PostRevisor/update_column when content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1 (app/models/topic_embed.rb, update branch). The new spec "Supports updating the post" only asserts the changed-content path via `post.cooked =~ /new contents/` and does not verify that `embed.content_sha1` is updated nor that a re-import with identical contents skips revision. This is a specific, diff-grounded testing gap rather than a demonstrable defect in the implementation.
